systems.platform: central services, trust services and middleware for API management and orchestration
systems.owner: Instituto de Modernização Administrativa (IMA), under the World Bank-financed PADA
systems.tiers: pilot of up to five public institutions and ten priority services or integrations

note: Terms of reference for a consultancy to support the PIAP; names no law or decree on data sharing, only that the diagnostic found legal gaps and that the roadmap rests on adequate legal framing.

facts.fact: Presidential Decree (Decreto Presidencial) n.º 46/18 of 14 February 2018 approves the national interoperability plan PNAGIA for central and local state administration, enters into force on publication, and states that adherence of public administration services to it is mandatory; the decree is a binding executive instrument, though the plan itself says its legal-level measures are still to be legislated.

systems.platform: transactional service bus (web services orchestration), digital authentication, electronic payments, SMS gateway, single service portals

facts.fact: IMA says the draft Digital Government Law, of 13 chapters and 107 articles, was put to public consultation on 6 May; it is meant to set the framework for digital public services and interoperability between state institutions.
